title: INFORMATIONAL PRESENTATION ON HISTORICPLACESLA REVEALED: LATINO LOS
text:
INFORMATIONAL PRESENTATION ON HISTORICPLACESLA REVEALED: LATINO LOS
  ANGELES, A CITYWIDE INITIATIVE TO INSTALL PHYSICAL MARKERS UPLIFTING THE
  CONTRIBUTIONS OF LATINO COMMUNITIES IN LOS ANGELES.

  Presenter:  Melissa Jones, City Planner, Los Angeles City Planning
summary: Informational presentation on HistoricPlacesLA Revealed: Latino Los Angeles, a citywide initiative to install physical markers uplifting the contributions of Latino communities.
